cohort: The study included all mothers who underwent LSCS at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, SKMCH, Muzaffarpur, Bihar, India, over a 6-month period, encompassing 200 out of 445 total deliveries.
finding: The prevalence of LSCS was 44.94%, with previous LSCS (42%) and failure of induction of labor (25%) being the most common indications.
mod_finding: The LSCS prevalence was 44.94%, and the study recommends efforts to reduce primary LSCS rates to subsequently decrease the most common indication of previous LSCS.
gest_age: Varied, with 5% <32 weeks, 25% between 32-36 weeks, and 70% between 37-40 weeks.
